scripts.title: FE Classic/Old Roblox Animations
scripts.features:
This is basically just a script for those who wants to have some classic animations! 

I hope you enjoy this script, now i dont know if it works in ANY game, but you can check yourself. (WARNING: For anyone who wants to use this script, please note that is resets your character, so if the game your playing makes you lose progress/data apon resetting, it ISNT MY FAULT!

This script is NOT made by me, and credits to Vixon on Youtube (I originally found the script here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zJ4819-Zzp4, go check him out, hes sick!!)

If you rlly read all of that, i appreciate you. I dont normally post scripts, im just doing this cuz its fun.

scripts.title: DontGrabMe
scripts.script:
-- skibidi toilet
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local blacklist = {
    "grabify.link", "iplogger.org", "webhook.site", "gyazo.in", "leakix.net",
    "bmwforum.co", "yip.su", "ipgraber.ru", "2no.co", "iplogger.com",
    "trackip.link", "boob.pl", "ip-tracker.org", "webhook.le", "requestbin.net"
}

for i, domain in ipairs(blacklist) do
    blacklist[i] = domain:lower()
end

local function isMalicious(url)
    url = url:lower()
    for _, badDomain in pairs(blacklist) do
        if string.find(url, badDomain, 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local oldRequestAsync
oldRequestAsync = hookfunction(HttpService.RequestAsync, function(self, options)
    local url = options and options.Url
    if url and isMalicious(url) then
        warn("[DontGrabMe] Blocked request to: " .. url)
        return { Success = false, StatusCode = 403, Body = "Blocked by DontGrabMe" }
    end
    return oldRequestAsync(self, options)
end)

local function hookExecutorRequest(fnName)
    local req = getrawmetatable(_G)[fnName] or getfenv()[fnName] or _G[fnName]
    if type(req) == "function" then
        local old = req
        local new = function(tbl)
            if tbl and tbl.Url and isMalicious(tbl.Url) then
                warn("[DontGrabMe] Blocked executor request to: " .. tbl.Url)
                return { Success = false, StatusCode = 403, Body = "Blocked by DontGrabMe" }
            end
            return old(tbl)
        end
        hookfunction(old, new)
    end
end

hookExecutorRequest("http_request")
hookExecutorRequest("request")

The GojoHUB Foundation Script is a script hub interface designed for modifying or automating game functions. It features a clean, dark-themed layout with three main tabs:

Foundation Mods Scripts – Contains foundational or core script options.

Lobbys Scripts – Likely includes scripts related to lobby settings or game setup.

Others Hubs – Possibly links or integrates other script hubs.

Under the selected Foundation Mods Scripts tab, three script options are listed:

Auto Rooms With HUB – Likely automates room creation or management.

Tester Tab click ; to Open – Suggests a test feature that opens something when clicked.

Locked Rooms Script – Possibly manages or unlocks restricted rooms.
